note: This file is a static configuration dictionary (not executable Python code). It defines model settings for a ResNet-18 ImageClassifier in the MMSelfSup/MMDetection framework. No functions, classes, or callable APIs are present.
configure_resnet18_model: configure a ResNet-18 ImageClassifier model with GlobalAveragePooling neck and LinearClsHead for 1000 classes
set_backbone_depth: set the ResNet backbone depth to 18 with 4 stages and PyTorch-style convolutions
configure_classification_head: configure a LinearClsHead with CrossEntropyLoss and top-1 and top-5 accuracy tracking
set_pooling_neck: set the model neck to GlobalAveragePooling for spatial feature aggregation
adjust_num_classes: adjust the classification head num_classes parameter to match the target dataset size
